worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.summary: Crush the held Berry and dash in with its element for one physical blow; both the damage type and power come from that Berry, which is eaten when the move is used even on a miss - and it cannot be used without a usable Berry.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.use.1: Turn a spare Berry into one typed hit
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.descriptio: Crush the held Berry for about %1$s physical damage of that Berry's type; both the damage type and power come from the Berry you carry.
After %1$s s of chewing, step forward up to %2$s blocks; the strike lands on the first enemy met and is lost if a wall blocks the way. Savoring chews longer but gives x1.3 power.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.preference: On: chew 0.4 s longer for x1.3 damage, good against one tough target; Off: a faster chew at lower power, good for a quick hit.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to take this bite; when off it stays put.
worldcombat.skill.naturalgift.descriptio: Whether it hits or not, the Berry is eaten when the move is used; it cannot be used without a usable Berry in hand.
On a hit that deals damage, the target is shoved about %1$s blocks in the direction of the charge.
